theses.proposition: Near-term commercial work is better analyzed as migration, integration and assurance than as a single algorithm purchase.
theses.reasoning: Guidance and implementation cases identify multiple organizational and technical work packages.
theses.countercase: Platform vendors may bundle much of the required capability into existing products.
theses.next_evidence: Non-duplicated procurement records, budget allocation, renewal terms and implementation outcomes.

theses.proposition: Published market headlines do not establish a reconciled PQC addressable market.
theses.reasoning: Market boundaries, time horizons and disclosed methods differ; adjacent quantum categories add further ambiguity.
theses.countercase: Detailed underlying reports could resolve part of the apparent difference.
theses.next_evidence: A shared product taxonomy, revenue-recognition boundary and transparent forecast-method reconciliation.

theses.proposition: Algorithm study, implementation assurance and protocol security require distinct evidence.
theses.reasoning: Construction papers, implementation attacks and protocol redesign investigate different failure modes.
theses.countercase: Standardization and mature implementations can reduce engineering uncertainty in a specified configuration.
theses.next_evidence: Version-specific implementation review, protocol assumptions, test configuration and independent assurance records.

theses.proposition: Deployment feasibility depends on the system boundary and measurement conditions.
theses.reasoning: Network behavior, constrained-device memory and interoperability affect different deployment paths.
theses.countercase: Some mainstream transport upgrades may be absorbed by existing platform update mechanisms.
theses.next_evidence: Matched end-to-end experiments and full lifecycle migration records for the intended buyer environment.

theses.proposition: Changing resource estimates motivate planning sensitivity, not a precise Q-Day prediction.
theses.reasoning: Algorithmic possibility, conditional hardware estimates and migration duration are separate variables.
theses.countercase: A buyer may still adopt a fixed internal planning horizon as a risk-management decision.
theses.next_evidence: Explicit hardware assumptions, uncertainty ranges, confidentiality requirements and migration dependencies.
